detail: Dave updated the field repo (other machine) to plugin 1.16.0 and checked .claude/worktrees/*/.twining/pending-posts.jsonl — none exist. The secondary hypothesis noted on #45 (hooks appending to a worktree-local .twining no server drains) is dead; the dead-letter fix shipped in 2.1.0 (39b1d7f) covers the actual loss mechanism (handler-throw → line deleted with swap file).
summary: Worktree-orphan hypothesis refuted: field repo worktrees hold no pending-posts.jsonl. The #45 drain-loss bug fully explains the stuck posts. v2.1 deployed on both machines.
